physics: exact H2g standard/CLS manifests; no recalibration; current 2804-slot hill mesh
candidate: exact B copy; add signed increments on permitted outer k/epsilon rows only; no velocity reconstruction
basis: archived eight k/eight epsilon and existing cold conditioning transforms; no regeneration
fixed: all velocity and pressure, inner k, endpoint K, inlet/interface scalars, dependent epsilon, fixed reference/defect and boundary data

sets.withheld: one terminal GL24 audit; not exported/used during search

mathematics.certificate_scope: fixed B gradient, sixteen signed scalar increments, declared finite samples and original [.5,2] bounds only
mathematics.scalar_bound_policy: Original hard [.5,2] envelopes in every LP; no tightened-envelope infeasibility claim

LP.variables: signed; finite redundant bounds may be derived from independent hard scalar rows, never default nonnegative
LP.row_scaling: normalize physical scalar rows by cold value, zero covariance by cold epsilon, positive covariance by K0, then by max(1,||row||inf,|rhs|)
LP.phase_I: covariance slack alone; all non-covariance bounds hard; no mixed distance objective
LP.obstruction: requires checked primal/dual/lower bound/gap and rounding allowance; infeasible status alone is inconclusive
LP.secondary: only after positive feasibility; weighted conditioned L1 departure from exact B, maximum four remaining rounds

tolerances.roundoff: export native constant-centred evaluator bounds; verify direct legal increments; include residual times implied coefficient bounds in the dual lower bound
